# Blockulator

> FP127: signed 127.128 fixed-point math for the EVM, 128 fractional bits
> (38 decimal places, 38 digits at 1) in one int256 against 18 for the usual
> WAD libraries, deployed as
> one callable contract on Ethereum Sepolia and available as an inlinable
> Solidity library. Every op is a read-only eth_call: no gas, no wallet, no
> transaction. For values above 10^-22 agents get results more precise than
> a double by calling it.


Current release: Blockulator 2.0 (FP127 v4 + FP256 v3, ladder v8), every address in
/contracts/deployments/RELEASE.json.

## What it is

- 49 operations: add, sub, mul, div, fromFixed18, toFixed18, exp, exp2,
  exp10, ln, log2, log10, log2Up, sqrt, cbrt, pow, powu, compound, gavg,
  hypot, inv, abs, neg, sign, min, max, clamp, avg, zeroFloorSub, dist, lerp,
  floor, ceil, frac, round, gcd, factorial, lambertW0, lambertWm1, pi
  (Ramanujan's series, pi(terms): five terms give 36 digits, 230 ULP from
  pi; more add nothing),
  log1p, expm1, sinh, cosh, tanh, atanh, erf, erfc, normCdf (the standard
  normal distribution function, the N(d) of Black-Scholes). powu, compound
  and the last nine are new in the v4 object, live on Sepolia since
  2026-10-15.
- Encoding: every operand and result is an int256 holding value * 2**128.
  Decode by dividing by 2**128. Range about +/- 1.7e38.
- Checked arithmetic: out-of-domain inputs revert with Overflow(),
  DivisionByZero() or OutOfRange(). Nothing wraps.
- Validated against mpmath at 200 decimal places: integer and rounding
  ops bit-exact; mul and sqrt round down and div toward zero, within one
  ULP; ln, log2 and log10 within two ULP; exp, exp2 and exp10 146 bits or
  better. The transcendentals round to nearest with 64 guard bits:
  exp(ln(x)) returns the same word for 10,000 steps.
  /data/precision.json
- Machine-readable op table (signature, selector, domain, reverts):
  /data/ops.json

## How to call it

- Network: Ethereum Sepolia, chainId 11155111
- RPC: https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com
- FP127: 0x6cFbCB928Ac068E84Ef793Dd1DFce4f8e9Cac1d1 (CREATE2 through
  0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C, salt "FP127 v4"; record at
  /contracts/deployments/FP127.md and /data/fp127.json)
- ABI: /data/abi.json. All functions are pure; selectors are in /data/ops.json.
- Example: sqrt(2) is `sqrt(int256)` with 2 * 2**128 =
  680564733841876926926749214863536422912; the result divided by 2**128 is
  1.41421356...
- Inline form: contracts/src/fp127/FP127Lib.sol in the repository,
  `forge install securedataresearch/blockulator`, remapping
  fp127/=lib/blockulator/contracts/src/fp127/.
- Manifest with the same data: /.well-known/agent.json

## The precision claim, as data

- /data/ladder.json: thirteen iterated scenarios (daily compounding, an
  amortising loan, exp(ln(x)) round trips, ...), 87 inputs in all, through
  FP127, FP127Lib, ABDKMath64x64, Solady, PRBMath, ABDKMathQuad, Balancer,
  Aave, Morpho, Maker and FP256 for N in 1..10000.
  Every cell carries the decoded value, correct significant digits against
  the exact truth (digits) and against the truth from the parameters as the
  library received them (digitsFormat, the arithmetic alone), the signed
  error in ULPs, and gas per step; summaries give median and range over the
  inputs; the methodology key says how each number is defined. Daily
  compounding, reference input, N = 365: FP127 36 digits (40 against the
  format truth), Solady and PRBMath 16, ABDK 17.
- Any cell of the deployed release (FP127 v4, FP256 release three; the
  datasets here describe FP127 v5 and FP256 release four, not yet deployed)
  can be re-run on chain: LadderRunner at
  0xEf689d3782490066fE911a6dD33357f59caE40fE (salt "FP127 ladder v8"),
  run(uint8 scenario, uint8 form, uint32 n, int256[] p) returns (bool ok,
  int256 raw, bytes4 reason, uint256 gasPerStep, uint256 gasTotal), with p
  the input's floored parameters from /data/ladder-inputs.json. Scenario
  ids are in /data/scenarios.json; the record is
  /contracts/deployments/Ladder.md.
- /data/gas.json: gas per op and form, min/median/max.

## Pages

- /data/edges.json: 139 one-shot probes at the ends of each domain (ln near
  one, exp at both ends, tiny roots and products, per-second rates to a
  power, both Lambert branches, erf/erfc/normCdf) through ten libraries,
  each cell with its digits or how the library had no answer (zero below
  its floor, revert, out of range, unsupported); /results/edges/ renders it;
  any cell re-runs through EdgeRunner.run(uint8 op, uint8 form, int256[] args)
  at 0x09b8fC41E872279A749a0221AE23D124079AcB44 (selector 0xf833b7d5) with
  the arguments from /data/edge-inputs.json.
- FP256 (/library/fp256/): a 256-bit binary float, release three: sign bit 255, a
  19-bit biased exponent (bias 262143) in bits 254..236, a 236-bit fraction
  with an implicit one; about 71 digits at any magnitude; no NaN, infinity
  or subnormals (invalid words revert OutOfRange); 28 ops: add, sub, mul, div, sqrt, exp, ln, pow, log1p, expm1, erf, erfc, normCdf, lambertW0, lambertWm1, powu, compound, neg, abs, sign, cmp, lt, eq, fromUint, fromFP127, toFP127, fromFixed18, toFixed18. Ops table /data/fp256/ops.json, ABI
  /data/fp256/abi.json, record /data/fp256/fp256.json; live on Sepolia at
  0x67eFfb11bF93c79a2B12cc7872cBaC12b3eB61be (salt "FP256 v3", the same
  CREATE2 proxy), Sourcify and Blockscout verified. Release four (in the
  source, not yet deployed) has 67 ops, each correctly rounded or exact, in
  four objects: FP256 (arithmetic, the edge, exp, ln, pow, conversions),
  FP256X (erf family, Lambert W), FP256X2 (exp2, exp10, log2, log10,
  log2Up, cbrt, sinh, cosh, tanh, atanh) and FP256X3 (min, max, clamp, avg,
  dist, zeroFloorSub, inv, lerp, frac, round, gcd, factorial, pi, gavg,
  hypot); predicted CREATE2 addresses
  0xA3C8C8700465F9e20Ff9dfA64066c2EF693Aa6c9,
  0x175246B258Cc0dC3efEFe74b5fac8cC52C0c40d0,
  0xE655bB8b1Cf848cAf3FD69F381289d144f5Bc697 and
  0x59D51481cb2EA924EC17FE263cd05b90CEF22383 (salts "FP256 v4",
  "FP256X v4", "FP256X2 v4", "FP256X3 v4").
- /results/ the headline numbers, /results/ladder/ the ladder, /results/edges/ the cliffs,
  /results/ops/ gas and precision per op, /library/ address, ABI and the op table,
  /why/ the mechanism, /writeup/ the story.

## Notes for agents

- Reads are free and need no key; do not send transactions for math.
- Sepolia only today; there is no mainnet address yet.
- The Vyper calculators listed in /.well-known/agent.json with
  "status": "archived", and the games and futures market on /archive/,
  are from the Huff era, do not call FP127 and are not maintained. Use the
  FP127 contract above.
